chapter: What You Would See (second minute — fold / last image / horror and wonder)
carry: Teaspoon grammar: when VO names a thing, that thing is the picture.
Mute test. At most one Orbit+distant-remnant hang — this minute needs ZERO hangs.
No PIL discs, oval billboards, halo bulges, or vertical clip walls in start frames.
One face, two arms, orange back on turns. Soft underside glow, no flame jet.

plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. The UNIVERSE FOLDS — spacetime warps, light sheets bend and crease, the sky itself folding. The FOLD is the subject. Continuous motion. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: flat untextured ovals, galaxy billboards, 2D discs, Orbit, HUD. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: A ring of warped starlight tightens.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. GOLD BEAT: a COMPLETE circular RING of warped starlight TIGHTENS — shrinking, cinching, getting smaller. Photoreal photon ring in vacuum. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: sphere cut by a vertical line, clipped geometry, rectangle of white, hard vertical cutoff, two overlapping orbs, flat discs, Orbit. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: The neutron star does not look like a distant Sun. It looks like a hole punched in the rules — still with a surface, still with a crust.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. ONE compact remnant as a PERFECT SPHERE with a visible CRUST / surface — not a living yellow Sun, not a black-hole void. Slow rotation showing crust. Keep a clean circular silhouette. NO outer halo blob. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: melted or bulging limb, second overlapping disc, living yellow Sun, event-horizon hole with no surface, Orbit, clipped geometry. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Already rewriting the map of every photon.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. Light PATHS rewrite — photon trajectories bend and remap across the frame. The PATHS are the subject. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: HUD labels, UI maps, oval galaxy sprites, flat discs, Orbit. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: What would your last clear image be?
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Medium-close on Orbit's visor FACEPLATE — searching, asking, last clear image. Cream eyes with pupils. One face, TWO arms. He TIPS / turns slightly as if hunting a last honest view. HARD FORBIDDEN: two faces, four arms, flame jet, Orbit-plus-tiny-distant-dot wallpaper, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Maybe not the star at all. Maybe the last honest photons from the galaxy behind you.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. Looking AWAY from the star: the last honest PHOTONS from the galaxy behind you — a soft milky band of distant light, receding, honest. NOT the remnant. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: flat untextured ovals, purple sprite discs, galaxy billboards missing texture, 2D primitive overlays, remnant filling the frame, Orbit. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: While ahead, magnetism and radiation erase the idea of a calm view.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. AHEAD: magnetism and radiation ERASE a calm view — charged-particle storm, magnetic sheets tearing the vacuum. Harsh, physical. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: calm wallpaper, oval sprites, flat discs, Orbit, grey ball. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: For a fragile moment, your eyes might still work.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. CLOSE on Orbit's visor FACEPLATE — cream eyes with dark pupils still WORKING, still seeing, fragile. One face, TWO arms. Tiny motion, not a freeze. HARD FORBIDDEN: two faces, blank white eyes, knockoff, four arms, flame jet. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Light can still arrive after matter has already started to fail. That mismatch is the horror — and the wonder.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. MISMATCH: a ray of light still ARRIVES into Orbit's visor while his body is already FAILING — tipping, stretching, losing the fight. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms, cream eyes with dark pupils. Expression through the EYES only. The light arriving vs the body failing is the picture. HARD FORBIDDEN: drawn cartoon mouth, frown line, smile, LED mouth, visor lettering, two faces, four arms, flame jet, Orbit hanging pretty next to a distant remnant, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.
